title: Scroll Area
description: A long list in a fixed frame, with a scrollbar that matches the room and a fade that admits there is more.
usage: For sidebars, logs and pickers that must not push the page around. If the content is the page, let the page scroll — this is for regions inside it.
a11y: Native scrolling throughout: keyboard, wheel and touch all work because nothing is faked. The custom styling is paint only.
